title: Granola for Apple Watch
excerpt: Today, we're launching a new version of Granola, built from the ground up for Apple Watch. It's built for meetings away from your laptop.
content_html:
Jack

July 28

Today, we're launching a new version of Granola, built from the ground up for Apple Watch.

It's built for meetings away from your laptop: like brainstorming at a whiteboard, walking 1:1s or candid advice over coffee.

Start with a tap

Tap your wrist to start taking notes. The screen turns bright Granola green and plays a sound, so you know it's working.

Then you're free to focus on the person in front of you. Tap again when you're done, and your notes are available on your phone and computer in moments.

Before a scheduled meeting, a subtle tap reminds you to start. For ad-hoc chats, you can add Granola as a complication on your watch face, so a new note is always one tap away.

The best wearable is one you already have

Instead of creating a new device for you to remember to take with you, we think the best wearable is one you're likely to have already.

We've been testing it internally for a little while. What surprised us is how natural it feels: many of us now leave our laptops closed – even in meeting rooms – while Granola takes notes in the background.

Your notes, wherever you work

Notes started on Apple Watch sync automatically to Granola on your iPhone and Mac or Windows computer, ready for you to review, edit or keep working.

Through Granola MCP, they can also become context in the AI tools you connect.

A limited edition strap, made by hand

To mark today's launch, we worked with London-based weaver Nowshin Prenon to make a limited-edition Apple Watch strap by hand.

We only made a handful. Each one is woven from a custom silk-and-cotton blend, designed to be comfortable all day. We liked the idea of pairing the Watch app with something tactile and carefully made. It's a small reminder to stay present and follow the thread of the conversation.

Available today

Granola for Apple Watch is available today, for free.

Download or update Granola for iPhone, sign in, then follow the Watch setup instructions in the app.

Granola for Apple Watch requires watchOS 11 or later.

Give it a try for your next in-person conversation. We'd love to hear what you think. So if you have feedback, drop us an email at hey@granola.so.

Jack, Marketing

content_html_zh:
Jack

July 28

今天，我们推出了新版 Granola，专为 Apple Watch 全新打造。

它专为远离笔记本电脑的会议而设计：例如在白板上集思广益、一对一散步或喝咖啡时提出坦诚的建议。

从水龙头开始

轻拍手腕即可开始记笔记。 屏幕变成明亮的格兰诺拉麦片绿色并播放声音，所以您知道它正在工作。

然后您就可以自由地专注于您面前的人。 完成后再次点击，您的笔记很快就可以在手机和计算机上使用。

在预定的会议之前，轻轻一按就会提醒您开始。 对于临时聊天，您可以在表盘上添加格兰诺拉麦片作为一项复杂功能，这样只需轻轻一按即可添加新笔记。

最好的可穿戴设备是您已经拥有的

我们认为最好的可穿戴设备不是让您记住随身携带的新设备，而是您可能已经拥有的设备。

我们已经在内部对其进行了一段时间的测试。 令我们惊讶的是它的感觉是如此自然：我们中的许多人现在都关闭笔记本电脑 - 即使在会议室 - 而格兰诺拉麦片在后台做笔记。

无论您在哪里工作，您的笔记

Apple Watch 上开始的笔记会自动同步到 iPhone 和 Mac 或 Windows 电脑上的 Granola，供您审阅、编辑或继续工作。

通过 Granola MCP，它们还可以成为您连接的 AI 工具中的上下文。

限量版表带，手工制作

为了纪念今天的发布，我们与伦敦编织者 Nowshin Prenon 合作，手工制作了一款限量版 Apple Watch 表带。

我们只做了少数。 每件单品均采用定制丝棉混纺面料编织而成，旨在让您全天舒适。 我们喜欢将手表应用程序与精心制作的触觉设备配对的想法。 这是一个小提醒，让您保持在场并跟随对话的脉络。

今日上市

适用于 Apple Watch 的 Granola 现已免费提供。

下载或更新 iPhone 版 Granola，登录，然后按照应用中的手表设置说明进行操作。

适用于 Apple Watch 的 Granola 需要 watchOS 11 或更高版本。

在下次面对面交谈时尝试一下。 我们很想听听您的想法。 因此，如果您有任何反馈，请发送电子邮件至 hey@granola.so。

杰克，营销
